official: 福生市の一般職の職員の給与に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 審議結果

name: 市職員の手当と給料表を改定
summary: 福生市の一般職職員の地域手当、住居手当、通勤手当と給料表を改定します。国と東京都の給与改定に準じて、条例を改正する内容です。
why: 国及び東京都の給与改定に準じるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Revises allowances and salary scale for Fussa City employees
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Salaries of General-Service Employees of Fussa City
en.summary: Fussa City will revise the regional allowance, housing allowance, commuting allowance, and salary scale for its general-service employees. The ordinance will be amended in line with salary revisions by the national government and the Tokyo Metropolitan Government.
en.why: The city says this is to bring the changes in line with salary revisions by the national government and the Tokyo Metropolitan Government.
